export const frontmatter = {"title":"SpaceBound","toc":"content","filename":"docs/layout/SpaceBound/index.en-US.md","lastUpdated":1778470761000,"order":19,"description":"Similar to Space of Ant Design, SpaceBound provides padding spaces.\nThe difference is that, the Space provides spaces between more than one component, the SpaceBound wraps it's child/children component(s), even there is a single child."};
